installCommand: if [ ! -d "flutter" ]; then git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git; fi && ./flutter/bin/flutter doctor && ./flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web
buildCommand: cd app && ../flutter/bin/flutter clean && export DART_VM_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=2560" && ../flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --web-renderer canvakit --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL="$SUPABASE_URL" --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" --dart-define=RAZORPAY_KEY_ID="$RAZORPAY_KEY_ID"
